title: Intel forms 23-company Korean AI alliance as it pitches HBM-free inference GPU
html:
Intel is courting South Korea's AI ecosystem on two fronts: a 23-company alliance built around Korean-made servers and an inference GPU that swaps costly high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for low-power DRAM...

The article requires paid subscription. Subscribe Now
summary: The D-Series is Intel's attempt to sidestep the HBM shortage.
